contentNote: SRD 5.2.1 feat mechanics have been reorganized into searchable structured data.

entries.title: Alert
entries.summary: Adds proficiency to Initiative and lets you swap Initiative with a willing ally at the start of combat.
entries.description: Alert is a origin feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Initiative Proficiency
traits.description: Add your Proficiency Bonus when you roll Initiative.

traits.name: Initiative Swap
traits.description: Immediately after rolling Initiative, you may exchange your Initiative with one willing ally in the same combat, provided neither of you has the Incapacitated condition.

entries.title: Magic Initiate
entries.summary: Grants two cantrips and one level 1 spell from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list.
entries.description: Magic Initiate is a origin feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Two Cantrips
traits.description: Choose two cantrips from one of the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell lists. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability for the feat’s spells.

traits.name: Level 1 Spell
traits.description: Choose one level 1 spell from the same list. It is always prepared, can be cast once per Long Rest without a spell slot, and can also be cast with available spell slots.

traits.name: Spell Change
traits.description: Whenever you gain a level, one spell chosen for this feat can be replaced with another spell of the same level from the same selected list.

entries.title: Savage Attacker
entries.summary: Once per turn, lets you roll a weapon’s damage dice twice and use either result.
entries.description: Savage Attacker is a origin feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Savage Attack
traits.description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, roll the weapon’s damage dice twice and choose which roll to use.

entries.title: Skilled
entries.summary: Grants proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools.
entries.description: Skilled is a origin feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Three Proficiencies
traits.description: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

entries.title: Ability Score Improvement
entries.summary: Raises one ability by 2 or two abilities by 1, without exceeding 20.
entries.description: Ability Score Improvement is a general feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Improve Abilities
traits.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or increase two ability scores by 1 each. These increases cannot raise a score above 20.

entries.title: Grappler
entries.summary: Improves unarmed grappling, attacks against grappled creatures, and movement while dragging an equal-size or smaller target.
entries.description: Grappler is a general feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.

traits.name: Punch and Grab
traits.description: Once per turn, when an Unarmed Strike hits as part of the Attack action, you can apply both its damage and grapple option.

traits.name: Attack Advantage
traits.description: You have Advantage on attack rolls against a creature grappled by you.

traits.name: Fast Wrestler
traits.description: Moving a creature grappled by you costs no extra movement if it is your size or smaller.

entries.title: Archery
entries.summary: Provides a +2 bonus to attack rolls with ranged weapons.
entries.description: Archery is a fighting style feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Archery
traits.description: Gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

entries.title: Defense
entries.summary: Provides +1 Armor Class while wearing light, medium, or heavy armor.
entries.description: Defense is a fighting style feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Defense
traits.description: While wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

entries.title: Great Weapon Fighting
entries.summary: Raises low damage-die results for qualifying two-handed melee weapon attacks.
entries.description: Great Weapon Fighting is a fighting style feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Great Weapon Fighting
traits.description: When rolling damage for a melee weapon held with two hands, treat a 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property.

entries.title: Two-Weapon Fighting
entries.summary: Lets the ability modifier apply to the extra attack made through the Light weapon property.
entries.description: Two-Weapon Fighting is a fighting style feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
traits.description: When the Light property grants an extra attack, add your ability modifier to that attack’s damage if it is not already being added.

entries.title: Boon of Combat Prowess
entries.summary: Raises an ability score and can turn one missed attack into a hit each round.
entries.description: Boon of Combat Prowess is a epic boon feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30.

traits.name: Peerless Aim
traits.description: When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead. This benefit cannot be used again until the start of your next turn.

entries.title: Boon of Dimensional Travel
entries.summary: Raises an ability score and enables a short teleport after the Attack or Magic action.
entries.description: Boon of Dimensional Travel is a epic boon feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30.

traits.name: Blink Steps
traits.description: Immediately after taking the Attack action or Magic action, teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

entries.title: Boon of Fate
entries.summary: Raises an ability score and lets you alter a nearby creature’s D20 Test by 2d4.
entries.description: Boon of Fate is a epic boon feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30.

traits.name: Improve Fate
traits.description: When you or a creature within 60 feet succeeds or fails a D20 Test, roll 2d4 and apply the total as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll. Recharge after rolling Initiative or finishing a Short or Long Rest.

entries.title: Boon of Irresistible Offense
entries.summary: Raises Strength or Dexterity, bypasses resistance to physical weapon damage, and rewards natural 20 attack rolls.
entries.description: Boon of Irresistible Offense is a epic boon feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 30.

traits.name: Overcome Defenses
traits.description: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you deal ignores Resistance.

traits.name: Overwhelming Strike
traits.description: When you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack roll, deal extra damage equal to the ability score increased by this feat. The extra damage uses the attack’s damage type.

entries.title: Boon of the Night Spirit
entries.summary: Raises an ability score and grants shadow-based invisibility and broad damage resistance in dim light or darkness.
entries.description: Boon of the Night Spirit is a epic boon feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30.

traits.name: Merge with Shadows
traits.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, use a Bonus Action to gain the Invisible condition until immediately after you take an action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.

traits.name: Shadowy Form
traits.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, you have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant damage.

entries.title: Boon of Spell Recall
entries.summary: Raises a spellcasting ability and sometimes prevents a level 1–4 spell slot from being expended.
entries.description: Boon of Spell Recall is a epic boon feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Increase Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 30.

traits.name: Free Casting
traits.description: Whenever you cast a spell using a level 1–4 spell slot, roll 1d4. If the result equals the slot’s level, the slot is not expended.

entries.title: Boon of Truesight
entries.summary: Raises an ability score and grants Truesight out to 60 feet.
entries.description: Boon of Truesight is a epic boon feat from the SRD 5.2.1.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30.

traits.name: Truesight
traits.description: Gain Truesight with a range of 60 feet.
